scope: SYNTHETIC Lantern Archive Cooperative: one year of managed security monitoring, 100 endpoints. Documentary technical review; no legal certification.
pricing_unit: 100 endpoints for 12 months, all fees and taxes included

requirements.criterion: Service contractually commits to AES-256 encryption at rest for all stored customer event data.
Tamper-evident audit logs retained for at least 365 days.
Administrator access requires both role-based access control and multi-factor authentication.
Binding monthly service availability commitment at least 99.9%.
24 hours per day, 7 days per week human incident support from service commencement.
requirements.conditional: 24/7 human support begins within 30 days of commencement, with 24/7 automated intake and business-hours human support until then.

requirements.criterion: Optional merit: documented included machine-readable JSON event export without extra fees. Binary all-or-nothing weight.
